title: BrowserBot MCP Tool Manifest Schema
description: Defines the schema for the auto-generated tool manifest file (mcp_tool.json). Used by clients to dynamically register and invoke the tool.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the manifest. Fixed at '1.0'.

mcp_tool_name.description: The exact name used for FastMCP tool registration.

description.description: A clear, descriptive summary of what this browser tool accomplishes, read by the LLM client (e.g. Claude) to choose the tool.

parameters_schema.description: The JSON schema describing parameter arguments expected by the tool function.

browserbot_version.description: The version of BrowserBot that built this tool.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of tool manifest generation.

source_session_id.description: The ID of the session that recorded the source Action Log.

site.description: The domain name of the target site.
